headline: European Natural Gas Prices Surge 163% Year-on-Year on Supply Constraints
summary: European benchmark TTF natural gas futures rose 12% month-on-month in October and 163% compared to October 2025. Tightening supply balances and forecasts of colder weather pushed prices to four-year highs.
why: Dutch TTF natural gas futures serve as the primary pricing benchmark for European natural gas markets and influence wholesale energy costs across the continent.

impacts.name: Dutch TTF Natural Gas
impacts.why: Tightening market balances and cold weather forecasts drove natural gas benchmark futures up.
